name: smartwear
description: SmartWear — premium fashion & beauty commerce platform (mobile, admin, API, workers)

scripts.api: cd apps/api && uv run python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:4000
scripts.api:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run python manage.py migrate
scripts.api:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python manage.py seed
scripts.worker: cd apps/api && uv run celery -A smartwear worker -l info -Q media,notifications,dispatch,scheduled,sms
scripts.worker:beat: cd apps/api && uv run celery -A smartwear beat -l info --scheduler django_celery_beat.schedulers:DatabaseScheduler
scripts.simulate:rider: cd apps/api && uv run python manage.py simulate_rider
